item.title: Review a rooftop garden trial
item.summary: A coordinator explains what a small gardening pilot actually measured.
item.transcript_text: Our roof garden has been running since April. The maintenance team reported that the stairwell below felt cooler, but no sensors were installed there. We did record the temperature on the roof. On six clear afternoons, the shaded pots stayed cooler than bare tiles. That's encouraging, though it tells us more about the surface than about the rooms underneath. The second phase will compare two similar stairwells with sensors before we decide whether to cover the whole roof. In the meantime, we'll extend the trial only where the existing maintenance team can reach the pots safely.

questions.prompt: What did the team actually measure?
questions.explanation: The team measured temperatures on the roof, with shaded pots compared against tiles.

To find out whether clear weather is common
